This game gives you 0 help when you do something wrong. You'll think you did everything right on a repair and everything is fine, but then when you complete the job, it informs you that you broke whatever you were fixing and the customer charges you for it. Doesn't tell you what you did wrong and penalizes you, good luck next time. No chance to fix whatever it is or double check your work. Most of the stuff in game doesn't have any system to tell you it is now working as intended. There's sometimes little tips written on the manual telling you "Use this fluid, no one can tell the difference." and apparently that's just a trap to ruin your run, because the customer sure can tell the difference and charges you for breaking it. The VR minigame is just awful. I can't express how boring and unrewarding it is. You are transported to a warehouse, lined with shelves, and tasked with finding a specific box with a number on it. I was trying to find box 483. It takes 15-20 seconds to scan an entire row of shelves and there are 6-7 rows. Most of the rows have nothing to differentiate them, but a few have numbers on the side. No clue what the numbers are for, because I only saw rows 1, 3 and 4 and box 301 was in row 4 and no sign of box 483. I still don't know where that box was because the game timer is still running in VR and I spent all my time scanning rows of boxes, never finding mine before it kicked me out to end the day and charge me for not getting rid of the ship.

[quote] [code][h1] 游戏由鉴赏家[b]杉果点评小分队[/b]提供[/h1] 给游戏选择困难症的玩家指路 成为我们的一员[url=http://steamcommunity.com/groups/SonkwoClub]小组首页[/url] 欢迎新朋友加入 [b]小分队群号：641445229[/b] (｡･∀･)ﾉﾞ [/code] 《Uncle Chop's Rocket Shop》是一款有着肉鸽元素的维修模拟游戏。玩家在游戏中扮演威尔伯，一位维修机械大师，使用一系列工具和设备来修复程序生成的宇宙飞船模块中的故障，从简单的维护到复杂的检修，争分夺秒地完成尽可能多的任务。通过阅读手册提高自身维修技能，用赚来的钱升级工坊，增加更多工作站以处理更大、利润更高的飞船。游戏结合了选集式剧情与多结局叙事，玩家可以与形形色色的角色互动，做出影响故事走向的选择。每一次游戏都会带来不同的体验，包括随机事件、隐藏谜题和神秘传说。游戏上手还是有一点点难度，不过耐玩度还是蛮高的，推荐喜欢维修模拟游戏的玩家尝试本作。 游戏有两种模式供玩家选择，两种模式将玩家的一日工作制分为了时间制和次数制，时间制在规定时间内修多少就能赚多少，客户的心情受你的修理速度影响，而次数制则是一天内只能进行规定次数的修理，对时间没有要求，而对于客户的心情则是受工作质量影响，并且在次数制中失误所受的惩罚会更大。不过我还是非常推荐前期玩家选择次数制，因为在没有完全熟悉各个维修板块，时间制反而收益最小。 https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3379662373 而无论哪种模式，最终的目的就是在规定时间内交付租金，并利用租金以外的钱来提升自己或者扩建修理厂等。而游戏的核心玩法就是上班打卡接受修理任务，随着时间推移交付的租金次数增加，派给玩家的修理任务难度也会递增，从最开始的单修理任务到后面多修理任务、致命高难修理任务等，不过难度越高获得的奖励就越多，在有的任务中还会获得收集道具、兑换道具等。而修理成功关键就在于笔记里，所有的修理要点都可以在笔记中找到，玩家需要通过对应符号找到笔记中维修记录页（符号类似于目录）。在笔记中会告诉你修理操作步骤，物品摆放位置，机械检修等技巧，不过唯一的缺点就是笔记目录搜索比较麻烦，一些专业名词指引不够到位，导致一些修理容易卡关很久。不过有的修理也是蛮有意思的，比如蠢行修理还能玩一玩2D平台跳跃游戏，真正的戏中戏。 https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3379662353 当你有足够多的钱之后，你可以用钱买更多的设施、扩建你的修理工厂亦或是购买更高级的物件来提升你的修理效率。完成修理任务有的不仅仅可以获得金币，有的还会获得福兆币，用于提升特殊事件，比如解锁更多的修理任务、增加保护罩等。 https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3379662435 游戏的玩法非常有趣，不过游戏的前期维修指引比较薄弱，以至于上手确实有一定难度。需要玩家沉下心来看笔记，了解各个维修原理，到后面熟练之后才会找到本作真正的乐趣，再加上肉鸽元素以及各种NPC事件，可谓是后期乐趣无穷！ [/quote]

超级无敌好玩！！！！！ 玩了十几个小时才发现可以做甜甜圈！做甜甜圈真的好好玩啊 树上有一些地方机翻感觉比较严重不是很准确，比如ai的true false翻译成真假：（ 核反应堆出问题和冷却、燃料同时出现的话能操作的世界太短了根本来不及操作 vr的启动序列判定真的很怪，好几次试了十几分钟了都没成功…… Please make vr enter timed boot sequence easier !!!

经历了无数次的重开，当我成功帮助uncle飞升成神，心情是无比的激动与开心。哪怕这个结局并说不上好，流程也多少有点复杂，但终于看到了。。。起码我知道了主角是可以打破循环的！！！！！ 这并不是一款看上去轻松休闲的游戏，也许你会被一开始的补充燃料搞破防，但请静下心来，不断尝试，魔法书里有着提示，直到完全掌握其技巧。随着游玩时间的增长，不停地循环，你开始不需要一直看着魔法书，就会发现这个游戏其实不难！！ 还是说一说问题吧。。。虽然有肉鸽的标签，但主角从头到尾其实没有太多实质上的提升（电动工具的帮助真的有限，希望制作组可以在后面的更新中增加一些），我正式版是以专注模式游玩（尽管demo时可以开疯狂维修），后面的维修有时修着修着半个多小时就过去了，要不断的试错，这疯狂维修模式的容错可能就有点太低了。有些模块的维修难度不太合理，例如蠢行的2、3关，过于吃操作了。。。。ai的调节情绪，反向推导加上固定数值，没算清楚真修不了。。。不少后期的模块都会和反应堆一起出现。但修反应堆的时间太少了，又非常容易出现燃料、冷却双空，稳定不到一半的必死局，比解炸弹容错还低。就导致一般情况下是不会选择修有反应堆的，一些模块就基本没修过，到boss战就直接傻了，希望制作组可以尽快调整，不然魔法书就白画了。。。。最后简中的翻译文本在有些地方出现了小错误，虽然不影响游玩，但还是请尽快校对！！！！ 总之，这是一款很有新意的游戏！！！让我们一起帮助威尔伯和卓斯打破循环|･ω･｀)！！！
谁在愚行的关卡里边埋那么多钉子的！这是个维修游戏啊，我一个手残的反应跟不上，天啊，2分钟不能存档来回跑，制作者你是在折磨人吗？我不明白一个维修游戏里为什么要弄一个跳跃小游戏，难度还不小，制作者倒是考虑下受众啊。真以为自己的小游戏的机制做得很优秀吗？真的忍不了！前边积累的乐趣全被磨没了，画蛇添足的东西就该有跳过的机制！！！退款！！！！！

RTFM - the game The game is enjoyable in its own right but more interestingly, it is a social experiment. Watch streamers and YT content creators play this for the first time and notice how too many don't read the manual and just start messing around blindly with devices they know nothing about. I'm not even talking about more complex modules like AI or Reactor maintenance. Even the simplest tasks become unsolvable problems (like "How do I open a service pannel, dur!"). The greatest module is the Remedy Lever. The manual comes with a simple, color coded 3 page instruction for it. "If the light is green: Do NOT pull the lever!" "If the light is red: PULL the lever!" If you mess it up, you gotta rewire the whole thing. "This could have been avoided by just reading 10 words two pages prior." is a nice touch in that section of the manual. I wish there was a way to tell how many people genuinely mess this one up by accident. Like I said, watch people play it for the first time and despair, realizing that this is the exact same behaviour you'll witness irl with supposed professionals (of any field of expertise).

I've put 40+ hours into this game because I adore it. The art style is charming and the tone is funny and charming. It looks and feels like an Adult Swim cartoon: it's goofy and crude and glib, but still feels earnest. I love the moment-to-moment gameplay. I like when simulational games make actions more atomic (ie rather than "push a single button to get into the car and start it", you push a button to open the door then another to get in, then to close the door, then to put the key in the ignition...). UCRS does a great job of this and also gives basic actions (flicking a switch, turning a wrench, attaching a part) a tactility that makes them satisfying and clicky. At a slightly higher level, the gameplay is learning and following procedures. There's a great sense of satisfaction to this as well: when you first fix a new module, when you fix it without using the manual, when you find small optimizations to fix it a little faster, when you start diagnosing multiple modules at once so you can make fewer trips to the workshop, etc. I'm about to get into my gripes, but if you enjoy 'procedural' games like [i]Papers, Please[/i] or [i]Keep Talking and Nobody Explodes[/i] and you love job sims like [i]Hardspace: Shipbreaker[/i] or [i]House Flipper[/i] or any of the car mechanic ones, this game is for you. You'll probably get a dozen or so hours out of it, so just buy it if the price is right for you. The game is fun and the devs are great. I struggle to give a broad recommendation because I don't think its for everyone, but if you're a freak like me then you'll adore it as much as I do. My main gripe is a big one, since the game bills itself as a "roguelite fix 'em up": this game should not have been a roguelite. The primary feature of roguelites is permadeath, which means players will spend a disproportionate amount of time in the earliest parts of a run. This is balanced out because new runs are full of possibilities: you can try a different weapon/character, pursue a different build, go for a side objective, take a tradeoff that removes one element of the game but superpowers another, etc. When it works, you get caught in an intoxicating cycle of "one more run" as the disappointment of failure is overwhelmed by the anticipation of starting again. UCRS doesn't work this way. There are upgrades within a run, but they they are fairly linear and are mostly to enable you to take on a wider variety of jobs. So the excitement/possibilities grow the later in the run you get, but the roguelite structure forces you to spend most of your time in the first few days, when you have the fewest job types available. After a half dozen runs or so, starting a new run in UCRS is painful. I get the sense that the devs are somewhat aware of this issue because in the obligatory roguelite permanent progression system, there is an upgrade that removes the most basic job type (refuels) from the pool of available jobs. IMO the gameplay would have been better served with straightforward progression where you slowly buy upgrades that give you access to more jobs so that your options are constantly expanding. Death just sends you back like a day (or maybe a week for missed rent) and the game continues as long as you want, rent ticking up just a bit each week (or as you buy more upgrades, or both). Finishing the game is just beating all the existing RENT day quests, but you can do them when you want and after you finish the game continues endlessly with no RENT or you can start over again. There's a lot you could add onto that (reputation system that determines the quality of clients, new kinds of workshop upgrades that remove some grunt work, etc.), but I'm just imagining a game that doesn't exist at this point so I'll stop there. My overall point is that the devs absolutely nailed moment-to-moment and mid-level gameplay loops, they are super fun and compelling. But those loops are hampered by the high-level structure of the game, which creates a lot of frustration and forces repetition of the least exciting parts of the game (ie day 1-3). I powered through that and have now seen like 97% of what's in the game, but I worry many players won't, and they'll miss some of the most exciting and interesting stuff in the game. And that's a real shame because there is so much charm and talent and creativity on display here.

Played this game for 5 straight hours and really enjoying my time, but as others have said this game really shouldn't be a roguelite. I'm cool with learning from mistakes but there's enough story beats that force you to die and start over - which is especially frustrating when everything clicks and you're slapping back down after gaining momentum. At the end of the second week you're introduced to a boss that throws a ton of new mechanics at you, and if you fail any of them you die and restart. I had to restart 4 times over to finally pass it (which felt so satisfying when I did), but I'm greeted to an unavoidable RNG death the next day when filling a newly bought fuel canister with liquid fuel and it exploded. If you do mix fuels by accident in a fuel canister it can cause a non-fatal explosion, but this canister was freshly bought, and to make matters worse I could not force a death by mixing fuels; so I'm left wondering how or why I died and how to prevent it which is kind of a problem with roguelites... but I guess I got an achievement out of it? Out of frustration, I had to put the game down; it really felt like the game didn't want me to enjoy myself. The art style and mechanics are SO good, but it's extremely held back by it's want to be a roguelike. I want to play more, but it keeps telling me "no". So while I really do like this game and can't wait to see what updates might bring, I'm not recommending it solely on the fact that Steam doesn't have a neutral rating. Definitely grab it when on sale, grab it full price after a few QOL updates and fixes, and try to avoid playing Frantic mode; Frantic in my opinion made the roguelite mechanics way more aggravating than they should be.

Starts off alright and fresh; the new tasks are challenging when they are still something you learn, but everything quickly becomes boring and you start to skip things to get to the bosses/side quests. Your unlocks are not very meaningful and it feels like you should use Cheat Engine to get over the weird hump of the first few rent days to get to the actual part you want to play. This is because there are parts of the game that are always the same no matter what, so it becomes like an unskippable cutscene where you have to click a button to move the dialogue instead of gameplay. Plenty of wasted potential but nothing the developer cannot fix by making your unlocks more meaningful or come online earlier (so you don't burn out on the boring stuff). Right now it's a roguelite with many repeated sections that play out exactly the same every play through. Additional note: the game can cause motion sickness because of the way your camera zooms in and out of the various stations you work in, especially when you are interrupted by dialogue while on a work station.

I wanted to like this game so much. And I just can't. I tried and tried because it has amazing art and I adore "tinkering puzzles" so I thought this game must be for me! It was absolutely not made for me. The game is incredibly hard, to the point of being unplayable for a casual puzzle lover. I expected it to be a fun puzzler, similar to "keep talking and nobody explodes", but single player. And it is, buuuut.., the time limit is absolutely unachievable in your first couple of attempts, because it's just impossible to read this fast. I abandoned the "frantic mode" and in "relaxed" mode the game is much more enjoyable. Buuuuut, just as I was enthusiastically reading the manual and tinkering with rebreathers I encountered an out of the blue platformer section that completely messed up my run. I just can't do platformers, this is why I don't play them. The ship with this platformer section kept appearing, and since I can't so it, I can't progress, because punishment for not fixing something is so harsh that it makes it impossible to progress past first 3 days. I'm so incredibly sad I can't play this game that I was waiting so long for. Don't know what am I doing wrong, since people seem to enjoy it, but it seems so unnecessarily incredibly difficult from the very beginning.

6/10 我是一个维修工，维修本领强，我要把那破飞船，修的很漂亮 刚开始玩以为可能就是修修东西，意想不到的给我一枪爆头进地狱了，这游戏比我想象中内容更丰富一些 游戏内容。：扮演一只四眼狐狸崽，主要工作就是修理飞船，赚钱支付租金，有一本魔法书（指导手册），在这上面有各种步骤 这个游戏的诀窍就是先维修失败好多次，然后死好多次，然后重开好多次（抓狂）（默默垂泪） 等终于记住了维修的各种步骤之后你就可以上手了 建议一开始不要选择限时的模式，当然选了模式后面还可以换掉 画风：意外的还算喜欢，角色带有外星元素，剧情穿插在修飞船的日子里，但是支线任务会缺少指引不知道干什么，比如那个卖礼包的不知道卖给谁然后失败了，总体感觉还有比较大的进步空间 新手引导：总体是属于需要摸索一阵才可以明白的，不是直接跟指引修东西，稍微有点挑战性，但最耗时间的是看明白魔法书上的步骤，不算非常难

游戏概念相当优秀，可惜游戏的章程安排十分糟糕 1、每种模块学习时间过长，且是没有任何说明全靠自己翻书一股脑全搬上来让你自己去了解，这是做游戏特别忌讳的地方，教程简单甚至无教程且游戏内容驳杂。第一次接触基本要至少消耗一整天（有时候遇到描述抽象的多个整天都不一定够）的轮次，但是高级模块只会出现在大型修理中，一个整天基本无法完成只能不断通过SL的方式反复练习。 2、模块可拓展性极低，三遍基本熟练，中期熟悉大部分通用模块后除非遇到特殊事件，基本就是流水线工作，可玩度变得很低 3、人物成长力极弱，除了不到10个金币升级以外，钱基本无用（可能我没接触到） 4、结合一二两点，超高的学习门槛+无聊的后续内容导致这个游戏的期待度断崖式下跌，心理落差非常大
并不是rouge类，也许是为了剧情需要刻意强化挫败感，完全没有想再开一轮的兴趣，所以说根本不是rogue。同时操作上很多交互细节设计得极差且没有必要(主要是拧螺丝繁琐而且交互困难)，每一轮都从第一天开始导致基本上没有新鲜感可言，完全是在通马桶。如果通过第一天后可以从第二天开始轮回，也许还有一定可玩性，目前来说就是纯粹体验送死和工作焦虑的半成废品

上头肉鸽+画风可爱，有些剧情，但是有些小瑕疵没法打很高分，比如一句时间太长太长，重开挫败感太大，比如顾客等待时间固定，非常容易不耐烦，不过小费也就三瓜两枣（有小费的话差不多10元，但更多情况是我遇到一辆破烂飞船啥零件都得我重新买了补贴进去客人还拉着张臭脸），导致做了顾客标签系统纯摆设（慷慨，耐心全部木大）只能说把客人都交给卓老大吧 比如哞哞盘的指引和实际操作有bug，除此之外其他模块的指引也存在缺陷，比如VR世界修复完全没找到书里介绍（或许也是我太菜）总体还是推荐一玩，等打折购入 顺便，我的steamdeck播放不了开头的动画，左摇杆选择可操控部件的时候也很不方便 以及有没有哥教教我肖普叔叔的RGB模块的气体是怎么搞的

It's really incredible how you can use a few great concepts and ruin it by mixing them together. I have played the same 3 days of this game now about 5 times. I started with the timed jobs - I don't generally enjoy time pressure, but it really comes down to how that is handled. So the intro and tutorial isn't terrible - there is a book with everything you need to know, here is a job you can repeat until you got it - fine. But the timed jobs require you to learn all possible repair tasks beforehand - not a fan. So, after not getting rent and being mashed into paste, I start a new game without time pressure (I thought). Three jobs a day is also way more than I could pull off anyway. Now I made the necessary money, and getting more the hang of the repair jobs. I quite like all the different machines and options of what can break and how to analyze them. I have the time to look into the manual - which of course isn't as straight forward and clear as you would like it. Then I get a new Job with a "Fatal" Tag. Well, I have all the time I need, right? Right? No. After getting the todo list with "Reactor needs immediate attention", I flip to the page in the manual, try to read the paragraph and then the reactor explodes. In the game mode I specifically went to, to have all the time in the world. Are you kidding me? Well, it is a roguelike. Even thought I don't know why it would be. Another run, and by now I'm a professional! I can fix most of the things without looking up too much. I have lots of money and this time it's not a reactor, but a bunch of pipe bombs. BUT this time I read what to do before accepting the job! I'm proud of myself! Then the next ship lands and the customer shoots me dead. This is my limit. I don't care anymore. Finally, a game where repairing stuff isn't a simplistic mini-game, but it forces me to replay the same scenarios with the same jobs again and again. I have failed multiple times to make rent or failed to open a safe - all my fault and going back didn't feel great but at least it was deserved. This didn't have to be a roguelike. How exactly is doing the same easy jobs again helping with replayability?

This game seems really promising from everything that I could've seen on the surface. I'm really disappointed that this game is the way it is because I want to like it, but the difficulty makes it either unprogressable difficulty spike or a snoozefest day you've done 6 times already.

玩法和分支上相对优秀，剧情也中规中矩，让我玩了不少时间。但是有几个严重影响游玩体验的问题，让我不得不给它一个不推荐。 [h1]翻译或文字描述上有问题[/h1] 主要是各种文字描述上的问题 / 翻译上的歧义 / 不够明确等。 例如[spoiler]哞哞盘的制作[/spoiler]，说明手册翻译得完全错误，必须去找网上攻略才能明白到底指的是什么意思。 还有，在[spoiler]黑暗之主路线[/spoiler]中出现的“将注入了三种所有化学品的蜡投喂”，没有明确是“一块注入了三种化学品的蜡”，还是“每种化学品各自注入一块蜡，共三块蜡”。同样的，在该路线中有关于“注入化学品”的描述，然而有一个地方的“注入化学品”应当翻译成“增强化学品”更加准确，否则会和普通的“注入”动作混淆。 以及[spoiler]反应堆模块[/spoiler]的开关没有描述向上是开还是向下是开。 类似的情况还有不少，导致我需要为此去查攻略，对于一个提倡玩家自学的修理模拟器游戏而言，这简直是毁灭性的打击。 [h1]容错过低[/h1] 同样的，在[spoiler]黑暗之主路线[/spoiler]中，忘记打印符文、忘记给仪式台编绳（绳子为什么不设计成永久的？）、仪式台放置的物品/蜡烛错误、蜡烛生成器容器没有关闭都会导致[b]不可逆[/b]的产物损失。最严重的是，前面这三种情况[b]一点提示也没有[/b]，很难确认到底是什么地方放错，再加上上述提到的说明书描述不清，使得[spoiler]该路线明明没有时间限制，却[/spoiler]反而成为最折磨我的[spoiler]路线[/spoiler]。 也同样是在[spoiler]反应堆和冷却器模块[/spoiler]，如果这俩和燃料模块一起来，你大概率只有不到半分钟的时间补充燃料并修复[spoiler]冷却器和反应堆[/spoiler]，就算完全理解模块机制，也几乎不可能修复（尤其是当燃料模块[spoiler]是电力类型燃料的情况下[/spoiler]），而做错一次就会导致全部重开。在一个修车模拟器里，故意营造出一个几乎不可能修复的模块场景，同样也是非常挫败的——即使你可以选择避开这个模块，但如果要避开，那设计这东西的目的是什么？就为了让大家“远观而不可亵玩焉”，或者用这种渺茫的希望让玩家几十分钟的努力全部白费？ [h1]Roguelike设计问题[/h1] 上述两个事情是相对比较严重的，但还有一个贯穿整个游戏设计的问题：这个游戏时间长，即死多的同时又缺乏构筑爽感。一般的 Roguelike 游戏可以游戏时间长且即死多，但必须有构筑爽感，例如 Noita、以撒的结合、杀戮尖塔等；一般的修理模拟器游戏可以游戏时间长且没有构筑爽感，但几乎没有即死，例如装机模拟器、冲就完事模拟器。然而这个游戏好巧不巧，三个全占了，导致一方面爽不起来，另一方面又要因为经常的重开和初见杀重复前一两个模块的内容。这游戏对[spoiler]支线[/spoiler]的引导又非常少（尽管这不是个问题，但和其他问题加起来就是火上浇油），导致我们有相当一部分时间在[spoiler]主线上[/spoiler]重复各种工作。 甚至即使不开“疯狂维修”模式，也会因为房租收不上 / 某些任务的某一个步骤错误（说的就是你，[spoiler]猪测试/各种支线的最后一天[/spoiler]）导致全军覆没。[spoiler]对的，游戏给了比杀戮尖塔还宽容的SL机制，但我们一定要用SL机制才能玩这个游戏吗？[/spoiler] [h1]糟糕的手柄支持[/h1] 首先，靠摇杆定位移动很容易移动到错误的位置。这在[spoiler]前照灯模块[/spoiler]的下方第二个滑槽开关、从燃料添加器的上拉杆移动到燃料棒处（容易移动到添加燃料拉杆）尤其明显，其他一些地方也偶尔有这种问题。 最难受的是我的摇杆根本无法旋转[b]任何一个[/b]旋转性的部件，对，任何一个。包括但不仅包括：[spoiler]身份识别模块的焦距调整、驾驶台的上方-右方-下方三向旋钮、维护肖恩叔叔全息影像模块中位置模块的“选择左眼/右眼/鼻子/嘴巴/帽子”旋钮[/spoiler]，使得我不得不在有些时候用鼠标游玩。 [h1]总评[/h1] 尽管游戏性、画面、音乐等看起来都还不错，然而却被糟糕的游戏设计和细节摧毁了整个游戏的体验，实在非常可惜。

I played this game through to the true ending on the Steam Deck and really enjoyed it. I also cannot recommend it. First, the controller support is janky as all hell. Placing the cursor on the object you want is practically impossible at times; I often resorted to using the touch screen, something I rarely use. Some objects that could benefit from the "fine movement" option seem to not have it implemented (and that feature is never tutorialized; it's left trigger). Second, I experienced a number of gamebreaking bugs which required closing and restarting the game to resolve, losing all progress on the day. Notably, entire modules or other screens seem to occasionally decide not to be interactable. I had this happen several times with the shop. I also failed to get booted from the ship on triggering the anti-tamper alarm on several occasions, which effectively softlocks the game. The game is fun, the mechanics are well designed, the world and art are compelling (though the writing occasionally needs a little tweaking), and the music is great (though it needs another song or two for the work day portions). So it's disappointing to not be able to recommend it due to its general brokenness.
